- Marketplace copy added (config + proxy copies byte-identical, no supplier traces)
- SEO: model guides for both IDs, models/pricing/compare/index rows, sitemap + lastmod, gemini-api-pricing landing flips 'announced' to listed rows
- VPS one-command onboarding: vps-add-gemini4.sh + DB script + public pricing checker

head_commit.message:
fix(seo): drop dead brand/blog/sitemap.xml line from robots.txt

The file https://www.keyoapi.xyz/brand/blog/sitemap.xml returns 404 (0 bytes);
blog URLs are already declared via brand/blog/sitemap.txt. Removing the dead
line stops Google from fetching a nonexistent sitemap via the robots.txt channel.
